meta.title: Kisumu County: coded Auditor-General findings (held; not on pages)
meta.scope: One record per numbered paragraph of the Auditor-General's report for each separately audited entity and year. Documents, hashes and opinions are in data/counties/kisumu/audits.json.
meta.rule: Findings are the auditor's observations on financial statements and compliance, not legal conclusions and not verdicts on any person. Offices and entities only: no personal or firm names. Amounts as printed in KSh; page is the PDF page. Titles are neutral summaries; the report's own heading is kept in report_heading. Every value is provisional until a reviewer approves it.
